description: This file defines the AttachmentsRecyclerViewAdapter class, a custom RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying a list of attachment URIs as images in an Android app. It manages a collection of URIs and inflates views for them, binding each URI to an ImageView.

classes.name: AttachmentsRecyclerViewAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass for displaying attachment images in a list.

classes.name: AttachmentsRecyclerViewAdapter.MyViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding a reference to an attachment thumbnail ImageView.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a single URI to the attachments list.

methods.name: addAttachments
methods.description: Adds a collection of URIs to the attachments list.

methods.name: clearAttachments
methods.description: Clears all URIs from the attachments list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder by inflating the attachment layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a URI from the attachments list to the ImageView in the ViewHolder.
